title: Alpha-R1: Alpha Screening with LLM Reasoning via Reinforcement Learning
abstract: arXiv:2512.23515v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Signal decay and regime shifts pose recurring challenges for data-driven investment strategies in non-stationary markets, where conventional time-series and machine learning approaches often struggle to generalize beyond historical correlations. While large language models (LLMs) offer strong capabilities for processing unstructured information, their potential to support quantitative factor screening through explicit economic reasoning remains underexplored. Existing factor-based methods typically reduce alphas to numerical time series, overlooking the semantic rationale that determines when a factor is economically relevant. We present Alpha-R1, an RL-aligned LLM framework for context-aware alpha screening. translated_title: Alpha-R1：基于强化学习的LLM推理Alpha筛选
translated_abstract: 信号衰减和市场状态转换是非平稳市场中数据驱动投资策略反复面临的挑战，传统时间序列和机器学习方法往往难以超越历史相关性进行泛化。尽管大型语言模型（LLM）在处理非结构化信息方面展现出强大能力，但其通过显式经济推理支持量化因子筛选的潜力仍未被充分探索。现有基于因子的方法通常将Alpha简化为数值时间序列，忽视了决定因子何时具有经济相关性的语义逻辑。我们提出了Alpha-R1，一个通过强化学习对齐的LLM框架，用于情境感知的Alpha筛选。其核心机制——语义门控，将每个候选因子的语义特征与动态构建的市场状态描述进行对比评估，从而筛选出经济逻辑与当前市场环境相契合的稀疏因子子集。
tldr: Alpha-R1提出了一个强化学习对齐的LLM框架，通过“语义门控”机制将候选因子的经济逻辑与动态构建的市场状态描述进行匹配，实现了情境感知的Alpha因子筛选，突破了传统方法仅依赖数值时间序列、忽视经济语义的局限。
en_tdlr: Alpha-R1 is an RL-aligned LLM framework that achieves context-aware alpha screening through a semantic gating mechanism, which matches each candidate factor's economic rationale against dynamically constructed market state descriptions, overcoming traditional methods' limitation of reducing alphas to mere numerical time series.
